text.p: Travelers Group Inc said Jon C. Madonna has been named a vice chairman of the company and will assume the new position effective February 1.

Madonna will have administrative responsibility for Travelers Group's international business development as well as for the personal lines divisions of its Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp affiliate.
He also has been named a vice chairman of Traveler/Aetna. Travelers has an 82 percent stake in Travelers/Aetna.
Madonna has been chairman of KPMG International since October 1995.
He previously had been chairman and chief executive of KPMG Peat Marwick LLP, the U.S. member of the international professional services firm, from 1990 to 1996.
"Jon Madonna has the depth and breadth of business experience that will be invaluable to our company's strategic growth," Sanford Weill, chief executive Travelers Group said.

"As the financial services industry continues to undergo change, both in the U.S. and abroad, we intend to be in the forefront of that process, anticipating developments and capitalizing on opportunities," he said.

"In his leadership of a large worldwide enterprise, Jon has demonstrated a keen administrative and marketing sense and the ability to design and focus a business strategy that produces growth and momentum. We are delighted to welcome him to the Travelers team."
